candidates.description: These tokens represent suffixes, roots, and common lexical components found in Hindi and related Indo-Aryan languages.
This vector is related to common Hindi sub-word prefixes, roots, and conjunctive elements.
This vector activates strongly for common Hindi and Sanskrit demonstrative pronouns, prepositions, and grammatical subword tokens.
These tokens represent Hindi vowel signs, nasalization marks, and dependent vowel modifiers used in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates on Hindi script tokens, including various syllables, words, and alphanumeric characters.
This feature vector activates strongly on subword tokens and characters commonly found in Hindi script and Devanagari transliteration.
This vector represents common Hindi word fragments and character combinations.
This vector is related to Hindi and Sanskrit character combinations, nasalized vowel signs, and conjunct consonant fragments.
This feature vector represents character sequences and subword units commonly found in Devanagari script and related Indic languages.
These tokens represent common subword units and consonant-vowel combinations specific to the Hindi Devanagari script.
